description: Retrieve a package from a package repository, and download it locally.

parameters.name: binary_path
parameters.description: The path of a helm binary to use.

parameters.name: chart_ca_cert
parameters.description: Verify certificates of HTTPS-enabled servers using this CA bundle. Requires helm >= 3.1.0.

parameters.name: chart_devel
parameters.description: Use development versions, too. Equivalent to version ‘>0.0.0-0’. Mutually exclusive with chart_version. Choices: false true

parameters.name: chart_ref
parameters.description: chart name on chart repository. absolute URL.

parameters.name: chart_ssl_cert_file
parameters.description: Identify HTTPS client using this SSL certificate file. Requires helm >= 3.1.0.

parameters.name: chart_ssl_key_file
parameters.description: Identify HTTPS client using this SSL key file Requires helm >= 3.1.0.

parameters.name: chart_version
parameters.description: Specify a version constraint for the chart version to use. This constraint can be a specific tag (e.g. 1.1.1) or it may reference a valid range (e.g. ^2.0.0). Mutually exclusive with chart_devel.

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: Force download of the chart even if it already exists in the destination directory. By default, the module will skip downloading if the chart with the same version already exists for idempotency. When used with untar_chart=true, will remove any existing chart directory before extracting. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: pass_credentials
parameters.description: Pass credentials to all domains. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: plain_http
parameters.description: Use HTTP instead of HTTPS when working with OCI registries Requires Helm >= 3.13.0 Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: provenance
parameters.description: Fetch the provenance file, but don’t perform verification. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: repo_password
parameters.description: Chart repository password where to locate the requested chart. Required if repo_username is specified.

parameters.name: repo_url
parameters.description: chart repository url where to locate the requested chart.

parameters.name: repo_username
parameters.description: Chart repository username where to locate the requested chart. Required if repo_password is specified.

parameters.name: skip_tls_certs_check
parameters.description: Whether or not to check tls certificate for the chart download. Requires helm >= 3.3.0. Alias insecure_skip_tls_verify added in 5.3.0. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: untar_chart
parameters.description: if set to true, will untar the chart after downloading it. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: verify_chart
parameters.description: Verify the package before using it. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: verify_chart_keyring
parameters.description: location of public keys used for verification.

examples:
- name: Download chart using chart url
  kubernetes.core.helm_pull:
    chart_ref: https://github.com/grafana/helm-charts/releases/download/grafana-5.6.0/grafana-5.6.0.tgz
    destination: /path/to/chart

- name: Download Chart using chart_name and repo_url
  kubernetes.core.helm_pull:
    chart_ref: redis
    repo_url: https://charts.bitnami.com/bitnami
    untar_chart: yes
    destination: /path/to/chart

- name: Download Chart (skip tls certificate check)
  kubernetes.core.helm_pull:
    chart_ref: redis
    repo_url: https://charts.bitnami.com/bitnami
    untar_chart: yes
    destination: /path/to/chart
    skip_tls_certs_check: yes

- name: Download Chart using chart registry credentials
  kubernetes.core.helm_pull:
    chart_ref: redis
    repo_url: https://charts.bitnami.com/bitnami
    untar_chart: yes
    destination: /path/to/chart
    username: myuser
    password: mypassword123

- name: Download Chart (force re-download even if exists)
  kubernetes.core.helm_pull:
    chart_ref: redis
    repo_url: https://charts.bitnami.com/bitnami
    chart_version: '17.0.0'
    destination: /path/to/chart
    force: yes

- name: Download and untar chart (force re-extraction even if directory exists)
  kubernetes.core.helm_pull:
    chart_ref: redis
    repo_url: https://charts.bitnami.com/bitnami
    chart_version: '17.0.0'
    destination: /path/to/chart
    untar_chart: yes
    force: yes

return_values.name: command
return_values.description: Full `helm pull` command built by this module, in case you want to re-run the command outside the module or debug a problem. Returned: always Sample: "helm pull --repo test ..."

return_values.name: msg
return_values.description: A message indicating the result of the operation. Returned: when chart already exists Sample: "Chart redis version 17.0.0 already exists in destination directory"

return_values.name: rc
return_values.description: Helm pull command return code Returned: always Sample: 1

return_values.name: stderr
return_values.description: Full `helm pull` command stderr, in case you want to display it or examine the event log Returned: always Sample: ""

return_values.name: stdout
return_values.description: Full `helm pull` command stdout, in case you want to display it or examine the event log Returned: always Sample: ""
